blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — Three separate fires were reported in Cebu City and Lapu-Lapu City on Sunday, November 1, as residents observed All Saints’ Day, one of the days of the season locally known as Kalag-Kalag. Two of the fires broke out in Barangays Lahug and Mambaling in Cebu City, while another was reported in Barangay Canjulao in Lapu-Lapu City. Authorities were responding to the incidents as of Sunday evening, with the fire in Mambaling reaching the third alarm.
